senses.gloss:
dyaus
(‘that which shines’)
------------------------------------------
Derived from the root ‘div’ (= to shine) the word ‘dyaus’ or ‘dyo’ represents हेअवेन्, the region of light. It is sometimes treated as a deity, as the ड़थेर् of both gods and human beings. पृथ्वी is considered as the मोथेर्. Hence the use of the word ‘dyāvāpṛthivī’ as the parents of all beings. These divine parents are invoked to give their worshippers rains, ड़ोओद्, wealth and success in life.
